remarks: Welcome to 21142 Brookhurst Street, a fully reimagined residence in the heart of South Huntington Beach, where elevated design, thoughtful craftsmanship, and modern California living come together. Extensively renovated from top to bottom, this exceptional 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offers approximately 2,040 square feet of beautifully curated living space, including the rare luxury of TWO PRIMARY SUITES. Step inside to a bright, open interior featuring new dual-pane windows, natural oak-look flooring, recessed lighting, and stylish finishes throughout.
